lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three most posterior lines terminate abruptly mid-flank, failing to reach the ventral margin of the torso mass unlike the anterior segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of two high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, situated superior to the hock joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower haunch align horizontally to form a short geometric segment parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The primary horn follows a posterodorsal spiral trajectory, exhibiting a lyrate curvature relative to the cranial base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 15% of the total visible vertical length of the primary horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest along the spinal ridge; white facial markings including two cheek spots and a chevron between the eyes; high-contrast orange-tan distal limb segments (socks).
